results.question: I keep getting severe headaches and my vision goes blurry sometimes. I also had a seizure last week.
results.answer: Based on the context, you may want to consult Dr. Elena Rostova, the neurologist, who specializes in conditions related to severe throbbing headaches, persistent numbness, and seizures, among other symptoms [1]. Additionally, Dr. David Sterling, the ophthalmologist, may also be relevant since blurry vision is one of the symptoms he addresses [3].

results.question: My knee is swollen and painful after a sports injury. I am having trouble walking and bending my leg.
results.answer: Based on the information provided, you may want to consult Dr. Marcus Vance, who specializes in orthopedic conditions. Common symptoms he treats include swelling around the ankle after a minor twist and sharp joint pain, which may relate to your knee injury. His consultation hours are Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM [1].

results.question: I have a persistent itchy rash on my arms and my skin is becoming very dry and flaky with red patches.
results.answer: Based on the symptoms you described (persistent itchy rash, dry and flaky skin with red patches), it sounds like you may have a condition that falls under the expertise of a dermatologist. Dr. Sophia Chen specializes in conditions such as Atopic Dermatitis (Eczema), which includes symptoms like itchy red patches and dry flaky skin [1]. You may want to consider consulting her for further evaluation and treatment.

results.question: I have been having severe stomach pain, bloating, and acid reflux after every meal. Sometimes I feel nauseous too.
results.answer: Based on your symptoms of severe stomach pain, bloating, acid reflux after meals, and occasional nausea, you should consider consulting Dr. Robert Thorne, a gastroenterologist. He commonly deals with symptoms like burning sensation in the chest after eating, persistent upper abdominal bloating, and unexplained nausea and loss of appetite, which match your description. His consultation hours are Mon–Thu from 1:00 PM – 5:00 PM [1].

results.question: I am having difficulty breathing and I keep coughing at night. I feel wheezing in my chest when I breathe.
results.answer: It sounds like you might be experiencing symptoms related to a respiratory condition. Based on the provided context, Dr. Amara Okoro, a pulmonologist, lists common symptoms that align with your description: wheezing sounds while breathing out, chronic hacking cough, and frequent nighttime coughing spells. These symptoms are associated with conditions such as Bronchial Asthma and Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) [1][2]. It would be advisable to consult with a pulmonologist like Dr. Okoro.

results.question: I am always feeling very tired, gaining weight, and feeling cold all the time. My blood sugar levels are also high.
results.answer: Based on your symptoms of constant fatigue, weight gain, feeling cold, and high blood sugar levels, it appears you may be experiencing symptoms associated with Hypothyroidism and Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus. These conditions feature a common set of symptoms such as persistent fatigue and unexplained weight changes, which align with your reported experiences [1].

results.question: I have been feeling very anxious and depressed for months. I cannot sleep properly and have panic attacks.
results.answer: It sounds like you may be experiencing symptoms related to Major Depressive Disorder and Generalized Anxiety Disorder, which include overwhelming panic attacks, trouble falling and staying asleep, and persistent feelings of sadness and emptiness. I would recommend consulting a psychiatrist, such as Dr. Rachel Green, who specializes in these conditions and has relevant experience [1], [2].

results.question: My vision has been getting blurry and I see floaters in my eyes. My eyes also feel dry and irritated.
results.answer: Based on the symptoms you described—blurry vision, floaters, and dry, irritated eyes—it seems you may be experiencing issues that align with the common symptoms listed for Dr. David Sterling, an ophthalmologist. He notes issues including blurry vision when reading up close, seeing halos around lights at night, persistent eye dryness and burning, and floaters and dark spots drifting in vision [2]. It would be advisable to consult with him for further evaluation.

results.question: I have ear pain and difficulty hearing. I also have a blocked and runny nose with a sore throat.
results.answer: Based on the provided context, the symptoms you describe—ear pain, difficulty hearing, a blocked and runny nose, and a sore throat—are aligned with the common symptoms of an ENT specialist. Dr. Fiona Gallagher, an ENT specialist, lists similar symptoms including blocked nasal passages, chronic stuffiness, sore throat, and possibly ear-related issues like dull pressure and pain inside the ear [2]. It would be advisable to consult with Dr. Gallagher for your condition.

results.question: I have pain when urinating and I feel the urge to urinate very frequently but very little comes out.
results.answer: You may be experiencing symptoms associated with conditions such as a urinary tract infection or overactive bladder. A urologist, Dr. Kenji Sato, has experience with symptoms like burning sensation during urination and frequent urges to visit the restroom, which aligns with your situation. The consultation hours for Dr. Sato are Tuesday, Friday, and Saturday from 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM [2].

results.question: I have irregular periods with severe cramps and pelvic pain. I also noticed unusual discharge.
results.answer: You may be experiencing symptoms related to conditions such as Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS), Uterine Fibroids, Endometriosis, or Pelvic Inflammatory Disease, which are associated with irregular periods, severe cramps, pelvic pain, and unusual discharge. It would be advisable to consult with Dr. Sarah Jenkins, a gynecologist, who specializes in these conditions [1].

results.question: My child has a high fever, rash on the body, and has not been eating for two days. The child is very irritable.
results.answer: You should consult Dr. Jonathan Brooks, the pediatrician. Common symptoms he addresses include persistent high fever in infants, red itchy rashes across the body, poor feeding, and constant irritability in newborns, which match your child's symptoms [1].

results.question: I found a lump in my breast and I have been losing weight without trying. I feel extremely fatigued.
results.answer: You should consult Dr. Miriam Al-Mansoor, an oncologist. She has 19 years of experience and specializes in conditions like breast carcinoma, which is relevant to your symptoms of a lump in your breast, unexplained rapid weight loss, and chronic fatigue [1].

results.question: My legs are swelling and I have been urinating less than usual. My urine looks foamy and I feel very tired.
results.answer: Based on your symptoms of leg swelling, foamy urine, and extreme tiredness, it is advisable to consult a nephrologist. These symptoms are commonly associated with conditions treated by nephrologists, such as Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) and Diabetic Nephropathy. Dr. Victor Vance, who is a nephrologist with 16 years of experience, may be a suitable choice for your consultation. His consultation hours are Mon, Wed, Fri from 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM [1][2].
